summary: Require distinct declared execution units and deterministic bounded-handoff chaining for credited Adaptive Execution passes, then revalidate the merged Adaptive Execution behavior under the corrected discipline.
reason: PR #5 revision 6 recorded five SEPARATED semantic stages as complete even though they were effectively evaluated within one assistant response. The correction adds deterministic enforcement of unique declared execution-unit/boundary identities, ordered stage credit, hashed outbound handoffs, exact downstream consumers, next-pass consumption of the prior handoff, a closed historical exemption set, PR-scoped durable Git chronology requiring gate-before-credit and distinct first-credit commits per pass, and historical identity uniqueness across execution occurrences. Every ordinary pass, subdivided subpass, and reopened/redo occurrence must introduce an execution_unit_id and boundary identity that were not used by an earlier occurrence of the same change record. ISOLATED passes additionally require an isolation-boundary declaration. The repository still does not claim to prove a ChatGPT message/context boundary unless the host supplies a trustworthy boundary ID. Revision 8 reopens from Adversarial because the historical-identity gap was found after revision-7 Adversarial had already been credited.

supersedes_assurance.reason: The revision-6 semantic completion records overstated actual separation and are not used as evidence for the corrected review.
Revision-7 Adversarial completed before the historical uniqueness requirement for redo and subdivided execution occurrences was added; revision 8 therefore reopens from Adversarial.
